title: Parade scheme — Vanguard standard bearer
summary: A display-level scheme for the single-pose Vanguard standard bearer, painted from the individual blister.

target.description: Example Miniatures Vanguard standard bearer — 32mm plastic, single-pose, banner cast with the arm

steps.title: Armour plates
steps.instruction: Basecoat every armour plate with two thin coats of Deep Navy.

steps.title: Banner field
steps.instruction: Block the banner field in Warm Bone, keeping the weave texture visible.

steps.title: Trim and finial
steps.instruction: Edge the armour trim and the banner finial with Old Gold.

org.brushcodex.subject:identity.qualifier: original sculpt; banner cast integral to the left arm

references.note: Manufacturer page as it stood when this workflow was written. Secondary to the identity above, and expected to die before the subject does.

org.brushcodex.product:sourceContext.note: Deliberately a SEPARATE extension key. No consumer in this experiment reads it to decide subject equality.
